themes.label: Rotation, not rollover — index calm masks Mag7 weakness
themes.narrative: The index reads as an orderly pullback: SPY is only 5.3% below its 52-week high and down 3.02% over the month, while the names that dominate it by weight are in a much deeper drawdown.
themes.dataAnchor: Mag7 averages 18.56% below 52-week highs versus SPY at 5.3%, a 13.26-point divergence gap; weakest is NVDA at 35.8% below its high, strongest AAPL at 2.2%. Bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 1.7%, far below the ~40% stress threshold). QQQ is down 6.36% over the month and 9.09% over three months while IWM is up 0.61% over the month — the pain is concentrated in large-cap growth.
themes.counterRead: Credit says rotation, not rollover, but the tape inside the index is weak: META -12.38% and GOOGL -16.89% over the month, QQQ -2.24% on Monday. SPY is 37% of the portfolio by value, so index calm is the portfolio's ballast; if lending standards tighten, the rotation read breaks and that ballast goes with it.
themes.watchFor: SLOOS print above 10%, or the Mag7/SPY divergence gap widening past 20 points.

themes.label: AI infrastructure: fundamentals ahead of price, tested tonight
themes.narrative: The market is pricing the AI build-out as peaked: NVDA is down 26.09% in a month, SMH is 31.25% below its 120-day high, and semiconductor-equipment names sit 49-53% below their peaks.
themes.dataAnchor: Revenue keeps growing while prices fall: AVGO +55% YoY at 32.6% below its high (score 81, tier A, 42.1% FCF margin); DDOG +27.7% YoY, 80% gross margin, $1,001M FCF, 42.5% below its high (score 84, tier A); ONTO +41.5% YoY, 49.1% below its high (score 81); NVDA +61.4% YoY, 35.8% below its high with RSI 22.7. AMAT is 52.6% below its high and LRCX 51.9%; MU is $719.02, 42.7% below its high.
themes.counterRead: Fundamentals ahead of price is an opportunity only if the print confirms them, and the print is tonight: NVDA reports after the close (EPS consensus $2.49). A beat with guidance that holds is the catalyst that pulls SMH back toward Zone 2; a miss turns the same DATA_AHEAD names into the correction's next leg. No buys before the print.
themes.watchFor: NVDA earnings tonight after the close: EPS vs $2.49, next-quarter guidance, and the next-day close vs its $175 Zone 2 floor.

themes.label: Nuclear / AI power at the trough
themes.narrative: The nuclear and AI-power trade has unwound hard — the market prices the power build-out as stalled.
themes.dataAnchor: VST is $130.16, 31.2% below its peak with RSI 44.1; insiders bought $1.17M at the trough (conviction score 83, the second-highest promotion). VRT is $188.67, 50.3% below its peak. Over the month CCJ -18.55%, SMR -25.9%, OKLO -16.88%, URA -13.75%, GEV -16.17%; BWXT is 51.6% below its high.
themes.counterRead: Both VST and VRT are holdings, so this is a hold decision, not a new buy. The insider buying argues the drawdown is sentiment, but VST's revenue inflection reads STABLE_OR_DECLINING — the theme needs a demand-side catalyst, and the AI-power names will trade with NVDA tonight before they trade on their own story.
themes.watchFor: SMR, CCJ and VST: two consecutive closes without new lows after the NVDA print.

themes.label: Credit and rates calm, VIX elevated
themes.narrative: Credit and the curve look calm — HY OAS 3.23, 2s10s +0.27 — so the market treats this as an equity correction, not a credit event.
themes.dataAnchor: HY OAS 3.23 is below the 4% stand-down line; 2s10s is +0.27 (not inverted); real 10Y 2.95%; 10Y 5.15%; fed funds 3.88%. VIX closed Monday at 22.91, up 18.7% on the day, at its 5-day high with no rollover, and up 24.24% over 20 days.
themes.counterRead: Calm credit plus a VIX spike is the 'correction, not crisis' pattern until it is not. VIX above 25 trips the stand-down; an earnings-night gap in NVDA can do that in one session. FOMC minutes land tomorrow (Wed Nov 18) with rate-cut hopes already fading in the headlines — a second volatility event inside 24 hours.
themes.watchFor: VIX close above 25 or HY OAS above 4% (stand-down); VIX close below 20 after the spike (fear rolling over).

themes.label: Leveraged and crypto complex unwinding together
themes.narrative: The leveraged complex is being sold as one risk bucket — TQQQ, leveraged single-stock ETFs and crypto proxies falling together.
themes.dataAnchor: Over the month: CONL -55.08% (-12.17% Monday), TQQQ -21.3% (-6.93% Monday), BMNR -24.54% (-7.03% Monday), COIN -30.87%, IBIT -20.33%, ETH-USD -22.46%, DOGE -24.67%, BTC-USD -19.6%. Spot crypto did not confirm Monday's equity selloff: BTC +0.21%, ETH +0.07%, DOGE +1.07% while SPY fell 1.89%.
themes.counterRead: The unwind is orderly — no forced-selling signature, and spot crypto holding flat on an equity down day is the first non-confirmation. But TQQQ, CONL, BMNR and DOGE are all holdings; this is where portfolio pain concentrates if the correction extends, and leverage magnifies the NVDA print in both directions.
themes.watchFor: BTC: a second flat-to-up day while equities fall confirms the crypto leg is pausing; a fresh -5% day re-opens the unwind.

strategyPosture: Watch. No new money before NVDA reports tonight: the mechanical tally is 1 of 4 (credit only), SMH $461.90 and NVDA $156.14 are both below their Zone 2 floors, and VIX 22.91 is at its 5-day high with no rollover. Hold existing positions; the NVDX calls are a pure bet on the print, so size nothing else to it.
whereWaveBuilds: The next move builds on NVDA's report tonight after the close: a beat with guidance that holds pulls SMH back toward Zone 2 ($470-505) and tests the SPX failure zone $7,750-7,820; a miss accelerates the correction toward the SPX 200-day at $7,342.71. FOMC minutes tomorrow are the second trigger.
watchFor: NVDA earnings tonight after the close: EPS vs the $2.49 consensus and guidance; then whether NVDA reclaims its $175 Zone 2 floor on a close.
SMH close back above its $470 Zone 2 floor; a close below $461.90 extends the breakdown.
VIX close above 25 or HY OAS above 4% trips the stand-down; a close below 20 after the spike signals fear rolling over.
SPX close vs its 200-day $7,342.71 (Monday close $7,416.59, +1.01% above); a close below confirms the next leg.
FOMC minutes Wed Nov 18: a hawkish read with the 10Y above 5.15% adds pressure to long-duration growth.

reaction.episode: CORRECTION episode, data through the Nov 16 close (pre-market Nov 17): SPX 7,416.59 is 5.46% below its 120-day high, 3.2% below its 50-day and 1.01% above its 200-day; SMH $461.90 is below Zone 2 (31.25% drawdown, 11.88% below its 200-day); NVDA $156.14 is below Zone 2 (35.84% drawdown, RSI 22.7); VIX 22.91 at its 5-day high with no rollover; HY OAS 3.23 calm; mechanical tally 1 of 4 (credit only).

ladder.response: Hold cash, no buys; wait for a failed first bounce and a second low that holds before re-checking bottom conditions.

ladder.trigger: NVDA gaps up on the print and SPX bounces into the failure zone $7,750-7,820, or SMH into $580-600
ladder.response: Treat as the bull-trap test: no chasing. Require a close above the zone plus a tally of at least 3 before any Add.

ladder.trigger: VIX closes above 25 or HY OAS above 4%
ladder.response: Stand down all deployment until both are back below their lines; no averaging down in TQQQ, CONL or BMNR.

ladder.trigger: NVDA closes back above $175 AND SMH closes inside Zone 2 $470-505 AND tally at least 3 of 4
ladder.response: Re-entry review: move the AI-infrastructure watchlist (AVGO, DDOG, ONTO) to Probe; size only on a second confirming close, not the first.

reaction.invalidation: An SPX close above $7,820 with SMH above $600 and the tally at least 3 voids the Watch stance and flips the posture to Probe/Add; HY OAS above 4% voids the 'correction, not crisis' read and the ladder with it.
reaction.trapRisk: Tonight's print is the trap setup: NVDA is oversold (RSI 22.7) and 35.84% off its high, so a beat can produce a sharp relief gap into the SPX $7,750-7,820 failure zone that fails within days. Entries wait for the failure-zone retest verdict and a second low that holds — never the gap-up open, and never on a VIX spike day.
